from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u087/system/state/workspace/programs/task-15c25221.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_divs = [r for r, row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != background]
    col_divs = [c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and g[0][c] != background]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_divs + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_divs + [w]
    blocks = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        if r0 >= r1: continue
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            if c0 >= c1: continue
            block = [row[c0:c1] for row in g[r0:r1]]
            blocks.append((r0,r1,c0,c1,block))
    source = next((b for b in blocks if any(v != background for row in b[4] for v in row)), None)
    if source is None: return g
    sh, sw = source[1]-source[0], source[3]-source[2]
    pattern = source[4]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1,block in blocks:
        if (r1-r0, c1-c0) == (sh,sw) and not any(v != background for row in block for v in row):
            for dr in range(sh):
                for dc in range(sw):
                    g[r0+dr][c0+dc] = pattern[dr][dc]
    return g
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'),globals())
